I have been seeing more and more complaints from the community. Some are well placed and reasonable, but some just don't seem to understand that not every update will be a hype update that everyone is happy with. Another issue is that when we are posting out of anger or discontent, we often fail to see the bright side or to show some understanding to the devs. The devs needs some credit for communicating and taking the community's feedback, although they may fail at times. This is a gacha game, the devs make money from the paying players to develop the game for everyone, and with how small the playerbase is, we need to show some understanding to the budget of the game. We can't have our ice cream and eat it too. We can't expect the devs to get 25 hours out of a day. The devs are not always making the best decisions, I agree, but they  have established a way for us players to voice our complaints and provide feedback so it is also important for us to make responsible use of it. I think that we need to show more patience and test things out before complaining. 

TL;DR i agree that chud Caro sucks and need immediate attention. I think we need to test things out before grabbing light by the scruff.

content:
Some stats are not as worth investing in compared to others, and I would like to gather opinions and possibly give some suggestions. The current stats are as follow:

- **Crit Rate\Damage:** In general they are core on most unit's that use direct damage, they geberally work and give a good boost because they include str and other modifiers at full force (could be possibly interesting if Crit Rate above 100% could be converted in crit damage at a 1\4 ratio).

- **Keyflare Regen:** It the lifeblood of most teams, is nice to have it and it has a diminishing return to not make so a single person can stack it all, is could be ok for now.

- **Death Resistance: **The conversion in hp is a bit annoying but it is a strong effect and can become problematic if too easily accessible, so **at the moment it could work as is**.

- **Damage Amplification:** This is the first **slightly problematic** one, it works well with base damage, but is also **the only thing that can incerase Fixed Poison and Counter**. **The major problem** is that they can't benefit from Strengh, Crit, and a lot of other damage boost don't work on Fixed aplications.        A possible thing to help them could be to **make so the Fixed sources scale with 1.5 or 2x AMP**, to compensate for the limited other ways to boost them. 

- **Aliemus Regen:** **Normally not a very used stat to increase**, it has a steep demising and is active only after you exalt, so if people care about theirs they have to find other ways to charge it before getting the benefit. I would initially **propose to possibly convert the final Aliemus generated to % in place of Fixed**, so units that has a higher base Aliemus, or in general unit's that exalt a lot in arc2, can benefit from it in a more meaningful way (like Caraboo).  **Other options** like charging 1\4 of the total Regen at the end of every turn (maybe reducing the amount you get after exalt by 1\4) could also be an option.

**CONTINUE BELOW WITH THE SIGIL YIELD SUGESTION**
thread_title: Stats, they could feel better

content:
**Black Sigils Yield: **This is **the more situational of the all**, but is fun to get more money to buy relics and upgrades, but the problem is that, if you miss even just 1 sigil, **you could lose a full relic and waste them all**, and it is a lot less relevant in stages with less battles.  
A possible solution could be **a fun new addition to the normal battle stages: The (temporary name) Daffodil "Last Line" Emporium**, a special Shop that open up right after entering the last boss tile, that let you buy very small increases in power with you last Sigils. They will be minor compared to a normal Relic, and they will have a limit on how much you can buy of a single thing, **as an example:**

**You have 50 sigil**, too little for a normal relic, so you enter the boss tile and the shop open whit options like this (examples):
- **1) **Increase Max hp by 0.1% per sigil, max 2.5%
- **2)** Increase AMP by 0.5% per sigil, max 25%
- **3)** Start with 1 str per sigil, max 25
- **4) **Increase aliemus generation at the end of the turn by 1 per 10 sigil, max 3
- **5)** Etc
There are a lot of possibilities on how it could be developed in time.  

What do you think? do you have other propositions to help improve the stat sistem?

- **Realm Mastery:** I already given an opinion about this before, but in general I think that his strength has to be revisited in the various realms and then give a diminishing return, so that you can give stronger effects, compared to what we have now, with less investment, and at the same time not make it broken if one stack too much of it. (in Ultra in particular, please make it a stacking number every turn up to 100 and not a random chance)

I agree with the sentiment that the updates are getting worse, but this post really doesn't make a good job at bringing up the actual points proving that, instead mentioning characters that are completely fine as underperforming for whatever reason. 

Not entirely sure where the conclusion about the changes being hostile to f2p players is coming from either, if anything, covenant bonding, while being a clumsy and weird system, does make those more accessible. 

My main issue comes from how directionless and half-assed the changes feel
- The raise of difficulty ceiling in DTide is welcome, but comes in the form of higher numbers, which was the most boring possible way of doing that, that ultimately just speeds up the powercreep. 
- The addition of gnosis to DTide is a weird bandage solution to making it *more casual friendly*, that also opens the avenue for BIAV to completely disregard the balance of the future encounters, justifying it by the ability to revive. It also contradicts BIAV's argument for disabling auto in DTide.
- Covenant bonding in its second iteration is fine overall, but still feels like a weird system that doesn't really fit well into the game.
- The Scintilla thing genuinely looks like something that was hastily made in one afternoon. The design is so boring and unnoticeable, people straight up failed to see it and thought the white background was the Scintilla. Feels like a ton of wasted potential.
- Propagation Caro issue still remains unaddressed. Caraboo somehow managed to make it even more apparent, having 0 embryo fusion generation in her kit (outside of the laughable 10 with AA) and a realm mastery scaling on her posse in a realm that benefits the least from that stat. 
- All that is compiled on top of the fact that bugs with the freshly released Lotan: Cetarchon remain unfixed for over 3 weeks at this point.
